name: Apply Closet Shelf Finish (Brush + Mini-Roller)
intent: Brush edges and mini-roller flat faces of closet shelves. One coat per module invocation. Scenarios needing two coats list this module twice with interstage between. Brush_roll is the default closet shelf method — no removal, no spray setup.

tasks.name: Brush + Mini-Roller Closet Shelf Finish Coat

doctrine: Coat 1 at 70 LF/hr, coat 2 at 90 LF/hr — faster on second coat over primed/first-coat surface, same pattern as trim and door frame. Rates are closet-shelf calibrated from trim brush finish (80 LF/hr baseline).
